en.bdb: Dissembler will ultimately go to the hell-

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਨਣਿ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਚਮਕੈ ਟਾਨਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaanan cha(n)dh na pujiee chamakai Taanaanaa|

en.bdb: The glow-worm may glow as much as it likes but its shine cannot reach the brightness of moon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sair boo(n)dh baraabaree kiau aakh vakhaanaa|

en.bdb: How it could be said that the ocean and a drop of water are equal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀੜੀ ਇਭ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: keeRee ibh na apaRai kooRaa tis maanaa|

en.bdb: An ant can never equal an elephant; its pride is false.
A child's describing his maternal grand father's house to his mother is futile.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਦੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: jin too(n) saaj nivaajiaa dhe pi(n)dd paraanaa|

en.bdb: 0 dissembler ! if you have totallly forgotten that Lord who has bestowed body

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਹੁ ਮੀਣਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: muddahu ghuthahu meeniaa tudh jamapur jaanaa ||4||

en.bdb: And soul upon you, you will go straight to the abode of Yama
